This indicator measures the effectiveness of UNDP's efforts in raising public awareness and communication surrounding COVID-19 prevention in Afghanistan. It is essential in the fight against COVID-19 to bridge communication and information gaps related to the virus. The indicator is assessed through the following two components: This indicator measures the effectiveness of UNDP's efforts in raising public awareness and communication surrounding COVID-19 prevention in Afghanistan. It is essential in the fight against COVID-19UNDP's Project primarily focuses on improving public knowledge and understanding of the COVID-19 threat in Afghanistan. This is achieved through a multifaceted approach, including public health campaigns, the distribution of educational materials, and active community engagement. The overarching goal is to ensure that the population has access to clear, accurate, and comprehensible information regarding COVID-19 prevention measures, symptoms, testing, treatment, and vaccination. This indicator plays a pivotal role in evaluating the extent to which these communication efforts contribute to a well-informed and engaged community in the fight against COVID-19.
